
{{Tocright}}

[[File:Museum.png|thumb|300px|''The Museum'']]

= Museum =
The '''Museum''' is an indoor [[Locations|location]] in {{Caldera Park}} where players can place minerals into display pedestals to earn permanent stat boosts.  
Each display accepts minerals of a specific rarity, ranging from '''Common''' to '''Exotic'''. The '''Museum''' also has a [[Vault]] to the right of the [[Receptionist]], as well as a [[Manage Museums Board]] and [[Visit Museums Globe]]. 

== Staff ==
* [[Receptionist]] — Quest-giving NPC who manages the Museum.

== Extras ==
* [[Vault]] — Allows players to store extra minerals and materials 
* [[MVP|Voting box]] — Vote for the next [[MVP]]
* [[Manage Museums Board]] — Save different museum setups and quickly switch between them
* [[Visit Museums Globe]] — See what other players have in their museums

== Displays ==
[[File:Museum_Display.png|thumb|280px|''A Display Pedestal'']]
The Museum contains rarity-based displays.  

* For '''Common''' through '''Legendary''' rarities, each rarity has '''1 free display''' and '''2 locked displays''', one unlockable with money, the other with [[Meteor Shards]].  
* For the '''Mythic''' rarity, there are only 2 displays (money + shards, no free).  
* The '''Exotic''' rarity has only 1 display (shards only).

=== How it Works ===
* Place a mineral matching the display’s rarity to grant a '''permanent stat bonus'''.  
* Each display holds one mineral. '''Bonuses stack''' across unlocked displays.  
* You can replace a mineral at any time to change the bonus.  

== Ore Bonuses by Rarity ==
Below are all minerals that can be placed into displays, their stat bonuses, and the minimum weight required to achieve the max bonus.
